_comment: Whole-process memory for a real request, measured 2026-11-15 on Apple Silicon: the FastAPI app (macOS phys_footprint) plus Tesseract child processes (RSS), sampled every 100 ms while uploading, redacting and downloading a scanned PDF (pages rasterised at 200 DPI) with MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS=1. This is what a container memory limit sees; the engine-only numbers in memory.json are lower. Linux numbers on the host may differ somewhat - watch the platform memory graph. Script: scratchpad mem_request.py (TestClient + footprint/ps sampling).
